8 ‘Safe’ Stocks That Are Much Riskier Than They Look
Shares of RTX, a defense company, look relatively safe but can have big drops when the broader market is volatile. Above, a model of a Pratt & Whitney RTX GTF engine. (Al Drago/Bloomberg)
You’ve lost your taste for risk with all the talk of CoreWeave’s debt and an AI bubble about to pop. You crave safe, lower-risk stocks that would—in theory—hold up well in a market selloff.
